page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; one note in the right margin beside the lines "pua fuêre" and "vifia id servaretur"; catchword at the lower right; signature "M 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: quibus erat controversia, formata ab ipso pars utraque acquiesceret, & consentiret, quæ vim juris habèrent interea, dum judicio integro tota causa finiretur. Consensus is solenniter initus & signatus in curiâ Groninganâ die iv & v Augusti, anno M. D. LXIV. Capitum præcipua fuêre : Infrumento ἐπιχωείῳ [?] & cervisia idservaretur, quod esset fadere anni M. Conventus autore Philippo Cobelio. CCCC. LXXXII definitum: pecora equini & bubuli generis venalia Groninga in foro fisterentur, ista biduo, hac uno die horis antemeridianis: quo facto, liceret, soluto vectigali usitato, quolibet abigere: butyrum, caseì, lardum, sevum, adeps, terga bubula Groninga & non alibi venum proponerentur, venderenturve: peregrino nihil horum, nec pecorum, nec cæterorum emere in agro liceret, in foro Groningano liceret cuivis, civi, agricolæ, peregrino, liberaque emptorum exportatio esset vectigali soluto. Mercatus solennes in commodum negotiationum plures in urbe instituerentur. Exempta fori juri essent pecora pastionis causâ aliunde in agrum adducta: venalia navibus advecta si esculenta & corruptioni subitæ [?]

page.notes: The first line has no indent and begins mid-sentence, so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The Greek word after "Infrumento" is uncertain; it is copied as printed as far as it can be read. The catchword at the lower right is read as "subitâ" and is uncertain. Italic passages are marked on the basis of the slanted type and may be incomplete. The number "CCCC. LXXXII" at the line end is printed as "anni M. CCCC. LXXXII"; the scan shows "M." at the end of the line and the continuation on the next line. The top right number "159" is printed as shown. The scan is slightly blurred in the lower lines, so some words are uncertain.
